notes.title: Dewdrop Dynasty | 🐝 Livestream #2
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Today is our final Steam Next Fest stream for our game, Dewdrop Dynasty.
The livestream will go live today, October 6th around 5:00 PM EDT!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999240/14acb19044b7db9e88d1dbc40e9244a96772ffdd.png

Come on in and join the fun!

About Dewdrop Dynasty

Dewdrop Dynasty is a charming neo-retro Metroidvania that includes cheese mines, power struggles, mecha crabs, and of course lots and lots of combat. And unlike most games in the genre, it features a light-hearted setting filled with strange and wonderful characters.


[previewyoutube=BZx9IgNk2s4;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for your support. We hope to make a really fun and exciting game when all is said and done.

Thanks!
Goodgis & the Firith Team

Support the game on Kickstarter: https://bit.ly/DewdropKickstarter
Official Twitter: https://twitter.com/FirithStudio
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/Ma8nqmHxSx

notes.title: Dewdrop Dynasty is now on Kickstarter + Free Playable Demo
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=dD1nRTzR_S4;full][/previewyoutube]

Dewdrop Dynasty Demo is NOW Available!
After a few years of experimentation, conceptualization, and development, a full demo of Dewdrop Dynasty is now free to play! It has taken hundreds of challenging hours to get to this point. Many beta-testers cried to bring you this demo (thanks Goodgis patreon supporters and Firith team). But we're not done yet! And for this next phase of Dewdrop we need your help. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999240/37a4c4ce26b970e3e62f03f92e2037a69b583cc9.gif

The Kickstarter
In addition to releasing a playable demo, we have also launched a Kickstarter to further support the creation of Dewdrop! With your help, we can better pay our team and contributors to make this metroidvania 1000 times better than it currently is. Backing the Kickstarter will also help us port the game to platforms like the Nintendo Switch. By supporting us, not only are you pre-ordering Dewdrop Dynasty but receiving more rewards and value. Last but not least, having a Kickstarter helps bring more hype to the project, which is always helpful when making something like this. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39999240/da07e5db6eaed2ed40ab09a800cd2835ded4de0c.png

Other Ways to Help
If you cannot back the Kickstarter, we'd appreciate if you spread the word about Dewdrop, and shared the demo to your friends and family who might like this sort of game. Of course, we would also like to get your feedback on ways we can improve the Dewdrop Dynasty gaming experience. 


Thanks guys! We hope you enjoy the demo. We're looking forward to finishing and delivering a really fun sidescroller.

~Firith Team
